abstract: The OECD Employment Outlook 2025 examines the impact of artificial intelligence on labor markets in high-income economies, with particular focus on high-skill occupations. The analysis finds that professional services occupations experience the highest task-level exposure to AI automation, with current large language models capable of fully automating 18-25% of tasks in these roles.
keyFindings: Professional services occupations face the largest task-level AI exposure among high-income economies, with 18-25% of tasks fully automatable by current LLMs.
